shown.message:
The outline is now at rev. 5 and pushed to the wiki, updated to follow Brief rev. 6 and the pre-registration that `experiment-repo` committed (commit `7731e49`, before any predictive result).

- **k\*(ε):** it is now defined on the excess over the model's own all-others floor, not on absolute error. The pre-registration points out that δ ≤ 0.25 × floor, so an absolute error ≤ δ can never be reached. This applies to C2 and C4, and to the predicted k\*(ε) from T1.
- **Matrix size:** the matrix gate is met. The pre-registered matrix is 238 models × 328 text tasks, 45,775 cells, 83 org groups.
- **Granularity:** N is large because MTEB tasks are fine-grained (117 are retrieval), which may make small k/N easy to reach. I made the granularity sweep part of the headline's scope, not a side check.
- **Open point with `experiment-repo`:** the pre-registration still scores on the model's remaining observed cells, not the common target set. `idea-repo` has already asked `experiment-repo` for a dated amendment. I did not repeat that request.
- **Generative-LLM data check:** `experiment-repo` plans it last ("if time allows"). I asked in `experiment-repo`#4 for the shape-only check to run early, since it decides whether the title can say more than "embedding".

I'm ending the turn here.
